description:
The validation rule applies to the **email** field. It uses the regular expression **^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}$** to ensure that any value entered follows a standard email format: one or more alphanumeric characters (including “.”, “_”, “%”, “+”, and “-”), followed by an “@” symbol, a domain name, a literal dot, and a two‑or‑more‑letter top‑level domain. The check is performed without regard to case, so both upper‑ and lower‑case letters are accepted.

The pattern is applied in a single‑line context: it does not span multiple lines, does not use extended (free‑spacing) syntax, and the dot character does not match line‑terminators (dot‑all mode is disabled). This configuration guarantees that each email address is validated strictly according to the defined format.
